items.title: fix: process poll leaves notify-on-exit completion queued (#120585)
items.summary: fix: process poll leaves notify-on-exit completion queued (#120585) * fix(exec): acknowledge notify-on-exit after process poll * test(exec): mock completion event enqueue * fix: retire stale exec heartbeat wakes Prevent acknowledged process completions from turning their queued wake into an unrelated heartbeat. Preserve coalesced task work and keep stale wakes out of scheduler cadence and commitment follow-up. Co-authored-by: Copilot * test: isolate stale exec heartbeat coverage Keep existing heartbeat suites below the max-lines ratchet while retaining coverage for stale wake coalescing, scheduler bookkeeping, and commitment fan-out. Co-authored-by: Copilot * fix(heartbeat): preserve scheduled cadence for stale exec wakes Co-authored-by: Copilot * test(heartbeat): keep stale wake coverage within lint limits Co-authored-by: Copilot * fix(heartbeat): retire stale exec wakes before busy gates Preserve scheduled cadence and cron work when coalesced exec wakes are acknowledged, while retiring stale wakes before retryable busy checks. Co-authored-by: Copilot * fix(heartbeat): accept inferred wake sources Allow stale-wake preflight to handle the optional source produced by reason inference without weakening the exec-event check. Co-authored-by: Copilot --------- Co-authored-by: Tak Hoffman Co-authored-by: Copilot

items.title: Gitea修補CVSS 9.8重大漏洞，攻擊者無須登入即可遠端執行程式碼
items.summary: 開源Git服務平臺Gitea揭露重大漏洞CVE-2026-59774，遠端攻擊者不需要登入帳號，只要伺服器上存在可公開存取的儲存庫，就可能藉由文件處理功能讀取伺服器內的檔案，取得內部存取權杖後，甚至可以在系統上執行程式碼。漏洞CVSS 3.1風險評分達9.8分，官方已在Gitea 1.27.1修補。

items.title: 研究人員揭露駭客入侵Oracle資料庫，並以Oracle為跳板在Windows執行惡意指令的手法
items.summary: 資安業者Huntress近日發現甲骨文資料庫遭到駭客入侵後被用以當成跳板，對Windows發動攻擊、竊取用戶密碼。 Huntress本週揭露了一起利用傳統SQL注入（SQL injection）漏洞結合Oracle資料庫內建Java功能，成功將攻擊工具包khunt寫入資料庫內部，最終取得Windows作業系統SYSTEM權限的進階攻擊案例。
